# SoulCause

> Evangelism consulting that helps churches return to the Great Commission by equipping the few, sending the many and multiplying disciples to the world. Led by faithful stewards of Christ with decades of service to the Kingdom; SoulCause keeps the focus on Jesus, the King and the Lord Most High.

SoulCause follows the sending model of Jesus: the twelve (Matthew 10), the seventy (Luke 10), then the world (Acts 1:8).

## Plans: SOUL (Send · Obedience · Unreached · Labor)

- **SEND** (The 12 · Matthew 10): For the core team inside one church: a sending assessment, a 90-day plan and your first twelve sent. Price: $49 per month.
- **OBEDIENCE** (Teaching them to observe · Matthew 28:20): NET services (networks, events and training in print, in person, virtually or outsourced) and the FIELD app, now in development. Price: NET services from $150; FIELD app $12 per month when it launches.
- **UNREACHED** (The world · Romans 15:20): For denominations, networks and ministries reaching people groups still waiting to hear, with the harvest field explorer. Includes REACH. Price: Starting at $150.
- **LABOR** (The 70 · Luke 10): For churches training labourers and sending them two by two. Price: $49 per month.

## Notes

- SoulCause measures faithfulness, never a scoreboard of souls.
- SoulCause does not give legal, tax or HR advice.
